a.lede: Marvell has agreed to acquire Lumentum for $115 billion, combining its optical DSPs, SerDes, silicon photonics, and networking silicon with Lumentum’s lasers, transceivers, optical switches, and InP manufacturing footprint.
a.title: Marvell to buy Lumentum in $115 billion all-stock deal

b.lede: IP house believes optics demand is going to explode as Nvidia and others eye bigger systems
b.title: Marvell wants to be a copper topper, bets $115B on photonics leader to push optical networking
